roadmap.title: Story on Normal
roadmap.description: Play all four parts and the finale on Normal without ever dropping to Easy. The story achievements are automatic, and the difficulty achievement needs the whole run kept on Normal.

roadmap.title: Substories
roadmap.description: Finish substories as each character becomes available and take the total to all 63, which closes with the Amon fight.

roadmap.title: Kamurocho side content
roadmap.description: Work through the city activities: hostess clubs and Hostess Maker, gang encounters, the Coliseum, Fighter Maker, revels, weapon modding, restaurants, lockers, memos and every minigame and gambling game. Start Hostess Maker early so Fashionista is not lost.

roadmap.title: Character and combat grind
roadmap.description: Level all four characters to 20 and finish the per-character money, weapon and distance counters that build up across the run.

roadmap.title: Ultimate Matches
roadmap.description: Clear the five Ultimate Match groups from the Main Menu after the game is finished.

roadmap.title: Hard and Legend playthroughs
roadmap.description: Replay the story on Hard to unlock Legend, clear Legend from that save, then claim the full set reward.

achievements.description: Acquire all achievements in the game.
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in Yakuza 4 Remastered.

steps.text: Earn the other 46 achievements; this final reward unlocks automatically once the last one is awarded.

achievements.description: Complete Part 1 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Part 1 of the story.

steps.text: Play Part 1 through to its closing scene; the achievement unlocks on the part's end screen.

achievements.description: Complete Part 2 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Part 2 of the story.

steps.text: Play Part 2 through to its closing scene; the achievement unlocks on the part's end screen.

achievements.description: Complete Part 3 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Part 3 of the story.

steps.text: Play Part 3 through to its closing scene; the achievement unlocks on the part's end screen.

achievements.displayName: Only One Thing Left to Do...
achievements.description: Complete Part 4 of the story.
achievements.summary: Complete Part 4 of the story.

steps.text: Play Part 4 through to its closing scene; the achievement unlocks on the part's end screen.

achievements.description: Complete the Finale.
achievements.summary: Complete the Finale.

steps.text: Play the Finale to its end; the achievement unlocks on the closing screen.

achievements.description: Clear the story on Legend difficulty.
achievements.summary: Clear the story on Legend difficulty.

guide.context: Legend difficulty appears only after the game is cleared on Hard, so leave this for last. Start the run from the cleared save with skills and gear carried over.

steps.text: Clear the story on Hard, then start @mechanic{New Game+} on @mechanic{Legend} difficulty from that cleared save.
Stock healing items and save before long fights.
steps.note: A defeat on Legend sends you back to your last manual save, with no continue or retry.

achievements.description: Clear all Ultimate Skill missions.
achievements.summary: Clear all 35 Ultimate Matches.

guide.context: Ultimate Matches open after the story is finished and are played from the Main Menu with no save file attached. The Ultimate set only appears once the other four groups are cleared.

steps.text: From the Main Menu, open @loc{Ultimate Match} and clear the 10 Melee matches.
Clear the 5 One-on-One and 10 Challenge matches.
Clear the 5 Team chase matches.
Clear the 5 Ultimate matches, which are boss rushes with no healing between fights.
steps.note: Exit the Ultimate Match menu every few clears so progress is saved.

achievements.description: Max out all characters to level 20.
achievements.summary: Raise all four main characters to level 20.

guide.context: Clearing the story and all substories usually gets most of the way there. Extra experience comes from the Coliseum for Kiryu and Saejima, from IF7-R (2,000 XP for a first win against each opponent) and from hostess storylines (10,000 XP each).

steps.text: Level Akiyama, Saejima, Tanimura and Kiryu to 20, using Coliseum, IF7-R or hostess storylines to finish the last levels.

achievements.description: Clear Normal Mode without reverting to Easy Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear the story on Normal without ever switching the difficulty to Easy.

guide.context: Clearing on a higher difficulty does not count, so a full Normal run is required. Choosing Easy at any point permanently locks this achievement out for that playthrough.

steps.text: Finish the whole story on @mechanic{Normal} difficulty and never accept the offer to drop to @mechanic{Easy}.

achievements.description: Complete or finish four substories.
achievements.summary: Finish four substories.

guide.context: Substories are optional stories marked by green question marks on the map. A best outcome adds a star and a lesser outcome adds a checkmark, but both count as finished.

steps.text: Resolve any four substories by reaching their ending.

achievements.description: Complete or finish twenty substories.
achievements.summary: Finish twenty substories.

guide.context: Green question marks on the map point out each substory, and more of them open up as a character's part advances.

steps.text: Resolve twenty substories across the four characters.

achievements.description: Complete or finish forty substories.
achievements.summary: Finish forty substories.

guide.context: Substories are optional stories marked by green question marks, and the count is tracked on the current save.

steps.text: Resolve forty substories across the four characters, checking the map for green question marks as you explore.

achievements.description: Complete every substory.
achievements.summary: Finish all 63 substories, ending with the Amon fight.

guide.context: Substory progress is tied to the current save. The last chain, the Amon fight, only appears after the other substories are done.

steps.text: Finish every substory for all four characters.
steps.note: Akiyama, Tanimura and Kiryu each have 16 substories; Saejima has 15.

steps.text: Complete the final Amon substory that opens once the rest are finished.

achievements.description: Order something at least once at each restaurant.
achievements.summary: Order food at every restaurant in Kamurocho.

guide.context: A character can only order while hungry. Eating Squid Bait, sold at the Docks, lowers health slightly so more food can be ordered.

steps.text: Order at least one dish at every restaurant.
steps.note: Sushi Gin on Showa St; the Underground Mall's Cuez Bar; Cafe Alps, Watami and Smile Burger on Nakamichi St; Pronto on Nakamichi St, with separate day and night menus; Matsuya on Tenkaichi St and Taihei Blvd, and Gelateria Kamurocho on Tenkaichi St; Bantam by the east side of Millennium Tower, and Kyushu No. 1 Star in Pink Alley; Shellac and Earth Angel in the Champion District; Kanrai in Shichifuku East; and Underground Gourmet in the sewers near the Eco-Store.

steps.text: Where a takeout option is offered, such as at Smile Burger, choose to eat in so the order counts.

achievements.description: Open five coin lockers.
achievements.summary: Open five coin lockers.

guide.context: Lockers need their matching key, collected off the street. There are 50 above ground and 50 underground, but only five need opening.

steps.text: Use five locker keys on any locker doors around Kamurocho.

achievements.description: Have a hostess wear a present you give her.
achievements.summary: Give a hostess a present she then wears.

guide.context: Clothing bought from Milestone in the Underground Mall is far more likely to be worn than other gifts.

steps.text: At a cabaret club, visit a hostess and give her a dress from @loc{Milestone}.
steps.note: The Strapless Dress suits Rio, Noa Mizutani, Erena Aihara, Shizuka Saito, Hiyori and Kyoko. The Mini Skirt Dress suits Himeka Kawasaki, Chihiro Ikki, Nanami and Maya Mori.

steps.text: Return to the club and let her appear wearing the gift; the achievement unlocks when she does.

achievements.description: Have a hostess invite you on an after-work date.
achievements.summary: Earn an after-work date invitation from a hostess.

guide.context: The invitation arrives by phone once a hostess reaches 8 hearts.

steps.text: Raise one hostess to 8 hearts by visiting her at her cabaret club.
Answer her invitation phone call; the achievement unlocks with the call.

achievements.description: Gather at least one outfit from each category in "Hostess Maker."
achievements.summary: Buy one outfit of every type sold in Hostess Maker.

guide.context: This is missable: once all three Hostess Maker girls reach #1 the shop closes, and finishing it afterwards needs a new game. The wardrobe only adds stock every three shifts, so spend some shifts idling to avoid finishing the minigame too early.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Hostess Maker}, buy one of every outfit type as new stock appears.
steps.note: There are 23 outfit types. Colours and accessories do not count, and the final stock to be added is the Long Two-Piece Dress, Cami Dress and Cache-couer.

steps.text: Keep buying new outfit types instead of pushing a hostess to #1, until every type is owned.

achievements.description: Receive business cards from all hostesses, including ones you train in "Hostess Maker."
achievements.summary: Collect a business card from every hostess, including the three Hostess Maker trainees.

steps.text: Visit every hostess at the cabaret clubs and accept her business card.
steps.note: Each hostess gives her card on your first visit, so the later card is not needed. The Hostess Maker girls, Hiyori, Kyoko and Nanami, count once trained.

steps.text: If the achievement stalls, make a club visit as a non-Kiryu character and pick No Preference.

achievements.description: Collect ten emblems from survivors during gang encounters.
achievements.summary: Collect ten Gang Emblems.

guide.context: Gang Encounters are Kiryu's side activity. After a gang's leader is defeated, its remaining members still roam the streets and drop an emblem when beaten.

steps.text: Start the activity by saving @npc{Akaishi} in @loc{Theater Square} from the attacking gang.
Fight gang members around the city until each gang's leader is called out, then defeat that leader.
After clearing a gang, beat its surviving members in random street fights until you hold ten @item{Gang Emblems}.
steps.note: Keep all ten emblems in the inventory at once, because trading them away early may stop the achievement from registering.

achievements.description: Acquire the title "Star of the Coliseum."
achievements.summary: Reach the third Coliseum fame rank, Star of the Coliseum.

guide.context: Only Saejima can earn this title; Kiryu can fight in the Coliseum but cannot earn it.

steps.text: As @npc{Saejima}, open the Coliseum in @loc{Purgatory} during Part 2, Chapter 4.
Win tournaments to build fame points until the rank titled Star of the Coliseum is reached.

achievements.description: Have one of your apprentices win the Rookie Tournament in "Fighter Maker."
achievements.summary: Have a Fighter Maker trainee win the Rookie Tournament.

guide.context: Fighter Maker is Saejima's activity and begins when Sodachi recruits him in Part 2, Chapter 4. Trainees fight on their own, so results are luck-heavy, and some players report the achievement failing to appear until they reload a save or restart the game.

steps.text: Train one apprentice over up to 50 turns, keeping stamina, mood and trust high.
steps.note: Hideo Sugiyama is the first trainee. Stretches and Rest protect condition, while matches raise trust.

steps.text: Save before entering the three-round @mechanic{Rookie Tournament}, then enter it with the trainee.
Reload the save and retry until the trainee wins all three rounds.

achievements.description: Create one or more weapons for each weapon category.
achievements.summary: Create a weapon in every weapon category at the modding shop.

guide.context: Each mod consumes a design source, a base weapon, the required materials and cash.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Kamiyama Works} weapon shop in Park Alley, run by @npc{Renji Kamiyama}.
Under Mod Weapons, create one weapon from each of the ten categories.
steps.note: The ten categories are Bats/Clubs, then Polearms and Blades, then Hammers, Knuckles, Tonfa, Nunchaku and Kali Sticks or Double Swords, and finally Guns and Others.

steps.text: Gather any missing designs, base weapons and materials from Beam, the Kamiyama shops and substory or activity rewards.

achievements.description: Acquire three Revelations.
achievements.summary: Learn three Revelations.

guide.context: Mack Shinozuka texts about photo opportunities. Photographing one and choosing the matching thought teaches a move, and a missed shot or wrong thought can be retried by leaving the area and returning.

steps.text: Follow @npc{Mack}'s text to a photo spot and use first-person view to look at the subject.
Clear the three quick-time shots of the scene.
Choose the thought that matches a fighting move, then repeat the process at two more Revelations.

achievements.description: Become a VIP member at the massage parlor.
achievements.summary: Become a VIP at the massage parlor.

steps.text: At @loc{Love in Heart} on @loc{Senryo Ave}, pay for a massage five times.

achievements.description: Smash the ball three times in one match.
achievements.summary: Land three smashes in one table tennis match.

guide.context: A smash is a Heat action unique to table tennis.

steps.text: While the ball is heading to your opponent, hold @mechanic{L2} to slow the rally and build Heat.
When the Heat bar is full, press @mechanic{Triangle} as the ball returns to smash it.
steps.note: A short cutscene plays on a successful smash. Land three in the same match.

achievements.description: Sing all songs at karaoke.
achievements.summary: Sing every karaoke song.

guide.context: Karaoke is at Karaokekan on Senryo Ave. Songs are split between characters and Saejima never sings. Haruka only appears in Premium Adventure and will not perform GET to the Top! until Otomeiro My Life is cleared.

steps.text: Sing each of the eleven songs and clear them.
steps.note: Otomeiro My Life and I Wanna Change Myself sing as Haruka; Machine Gun Kiss and Kamurocho Lullaby as Kiryu; Raindrops with a hostess or Hana; Pure Love in Kamurocho as a duet; GET to the Top! with a hostess or Haruka; Summer Memories and Shooting Star with Hiyori; Where Has Your Touch Gone? and Saturday Night Lover with Kyoko.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Premium Adventure}, bring Haruka to cover her two songs.

achievements.description: Achieve a hat trick in darts.
achievements.summary: Throw three bullseyes in a row in darts.

guide.context: The three throws must be consecutive within one set.

steps.text: In a darts game, land three bullseyes in a row.

achievements.description: Win the first point in Four-Ball billiards.
achievements.summary: Win the opening point of a Four-Ball pool match.

steps.text: Start a Four-Ball pool match and sink a ball to take the first point.

achievements.description: Achieve a turkey in bowling.
achievements.summary: Bowl three strikes in a row.

steps.text: Bowl three strikes in a row, retrying the frame set until it lands.

achievements.description: Play all non-casino gambling games.
achievements.summary: Play all four non-casino gambling games.

steps.text: At the @loc{Dragon Palace} gambling hall, play one round each of cho-han, cee-lo, koi-koi and oicho-kabu.

achievements.description: Play all casino gambling games.
achievements.summary: Play all four casino games.

guide.context: The casino tables are at the Dragon Palace casino, Park Blvd. or Purgatory. The game tracks no progress for this, and some players need a full match or a save reload before it registers.

steps.text: Play blackjack, poker, roulette and baccarat.
steps.note: Finish a full round or match of each rather than quitting early, and reload a save if the achievement does not appear.

achievements.description: Play all minigames at Club SEGA.
achievements.summary: Play every minigame at Club SEGA.

steps.text: At a @loc{Club SEGA}, play @mechanic{UFO Catcher} and @mechanic{Boxcelios 2}.
As Akiyama, run @mechanic{Boxcelios 2} three times, then befriend the @loc{Theater Square} manager, who will install @mechanic{Boxcelios}.
Play Boxcelios.

achievements.description: Achieve a promotion in shogi.
achievements.summary: Earn a promotion by winning a shogi match.

guide.context: Shogi Challenge 1 is the fastest win.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Shogi Challenge 1} and win; the promotion is awarded with the victory.

achievements.description: Win a round by forming a concealed hand containing seven unique pairs in mahjong.
achievements.summary: Win a mahjong round with a concealed Seven Pairs hand.

guide.context: A Seven Pairs hand stays concealed, so winning by Ron counts as well as by Tsumo.

steps.text: Build seven different pairs in mahjong and keep the hand concealed.
Win the round with the completed hand.

achievements.description: Successfully hit two panels at once at the batting center.
achievements.summary: Hit two batting-center panels with a single swing.

guide.context: Aim for the seam where two panels meet.

steps.text: At the batting center, swing at the line between two adjacent panels so the ball strikes both.

achievements.description: Golf and fish five times each.
achievements.summary: Play golf five times and fish five times.

guide.context: A golf round can be quit right after starting, and a cast counts for fishing even without a catch.

steps.text: Start and immediately quit five golf rounds.
Cast the fishing rod five times.

achievements.description: Possess 10,000,000 yen or more.
achievements.summary: Hold 10,000,000 yen at one time.

guide.context: The total must be held at once, so this is best saved until the late game.

steps.text: Build up 10,000,000 yen.
steps.note: Good sources are casino cheat-item wins traded for Platinum Plates, the story-clear payout (2,000,000 on Normal, 3,000,000 on Hard, 5,000,000 on Legend) and Tanimura's A Dangerous Game substory (3,000,000 yen).

achievements.description: Traverse 100 kilometers or more.
achievements.summary: Travel 100 kilometres on foot.

guide.context: Only distance covered on foot counts, so avoid taxis.

steps.text: Walk or run around Kamurocho and skip taxis until the total passes 100 km.

achievements.description: Knock over 100 people you pass by.
achievements.summary: Knock over 100 pedestrians by running into them.

guide.context: Only ordinary slim men and hunched older men can be fully knocked over, and only from behind.

steps.text: Run into pedestrians from behind around @loc{Theater Square} until 100 are knocked down.
steps.note: Do not retry the same person twice, because only a clean first hit knocks someone down.

achievements.description: Earn 1,000,000 yen playing as Akiyama.
achievements.summary: Earn 1,000,000 yen while playing as Akiyama.

guide.context: Money earned as other characters does not count toward this total.

steps.text: As @npc{Akiyama}, earn 1,000,000 yen.
steps.note: A fast route is to win casino points as Tanimura with cheat items, buy Platinum Plates, then switch to Akiyama and sell them.

achievements.description: Purchase five guns playing as Saejima.
achievements.summary: Buy five guns while playing as Saejima.

guide.context: The 9mm Automatic Pistol at the Rooftop Weapon Shop is the cheapest option, at 120,000 yen.

steps.text: As @npc{Saejima}, buy five guns; the 9mm Automatic Pistol is the cheapest option.

achievements.description: Acquire 10,000 casino points playing as Tanimura.
achievements.summary: Earn 10,000 casino points while playing as Tanimura.

guide.context: Casino points are earned at the gambling tables and count only while playing as Tanimura.

steps.text: As @npc{Tanimura}, play casino games until the point total reaches 10,000.
steps.note: Cheat items win the required points far faster than fair play.

achievements.description: Destroy 100 weapons you pick up playing as Kiryu.
achievements.summary: Destroy 100 picked-up weapons while playing as Kiryu.

guide.context: Only weapons picked up from the environment count, not equipped gear.

steps.text: As @npc{Kiryu}, pick up and break 100 street weapons.
steps.note: At the east end of @loc{Theater Square}, a crate of bottles can be picked up and smashed one at a time indefinitely.

achievements.description: Pick up twenty pieces of trash around the city.
achievements.summary: Pick up 20 pieces of trash.

guide.context: Trash lies on the ground and glows green when you are near.

steps.text: Pick up 20 glowing pieces of trash scattered around Kamurocho.

achievements.description: Collect all Memos in the Pause Menu.
achievements.summary: Collect every Memo in the Pause Menu.

guide.context: Memos are people marked with a blue arrow above their head; talk to each one as you travel the city.

steps.text: Talk to every blue-arrow character across all four parts and the finale.
steps.note: Some Memos appear only in later chapters, so recheck each part for missed ones.

steps.text: Once all are gathered, open Memos in the Pause Menu to trigger the unlock.
